<div class="card-body">
'''Timer Mine (Dark)''' is a [[Dark]] [[Weapon]] ([[Automated Weapon]]) from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)|Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">タイマー地雷</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">自分の地雷敷設ドロイドがいる位置カードの相手の側に配備する。次の自分のターンに「爆発」する。運命数を引く。そこにいる相手のキャラクターが運命数の数だけ即座にロストする（誰をロストするかは敵が選べる）。その時点でタイマー地雷もロストする。</span><ref name="jp1-face">Japanese text as on the [[:File:Japanese-Premiere-PSA-06-Face.jpg|Japanese Premiere printed face]] of [[Timer Mine (Dark) (Japanese)]]; checked line by line against this Two-Player face, which prints the same text.</ref>
<ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-Two-Player-Timer-Mine-Dark-C1G.jpg|This Two-Player printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">地雷敷設用ドロイドによって仕掛けられる時限式の爆弾。鉱脈やスパイス鉱山の爆破用に開発されたが、軍用に改造されている。</span>''
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Timer mine.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on the opponent's side of a location card where one of your mine-laying droids is present. It ‘explodes’ on your next turn. Draw destiny. That many opposing characters there are immediately lost; the opponent may choose who is lost. The timer mine is also lost at that point.

'''Lore:''' A timed bomb set by a mine-laying droid. Developed for blasting ore veins and spice mines, it has been modified for military use.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says to deploy at a location card and that the mine explodes on your next turn. The English specifies a site and the beginning of your next turn. The Japanese says the opponent chooses the characters lost; the English says their owner chooses.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Timer Mine (Dark)]] in [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 44, 105. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
